preamble.summary: Deuteronomy 23 regulates admission to the assembly of YHWH (Moabites/Ammonites excluded; Edomites and Egyptians admitted in the third generation). The chapter also contains laws on bodily purity and the prohibition of cult-prostitution. 4QDeutᵃ preserves vv. 25–26. 4QDeutⁱ covers vv. 4–15. 4QDeutᵏ² preserves vv. 21–26. Coverage is good.
preamble.notable_variants: No significant content variants. The Moabite-Ammonite exclusion (v. 4) tracks MT — relevant background to Ruth 4 and Neh 13:1-3.
preamble.scroll_condition: Multiple manuscripts together cover most of the chapter.

variant_notes: The Moabite-Ammonite exclusion tracks MT. Cited at Neh 13:1.
The grain-plucking-from-a-neighbor's-field permission tracks MT. Echoed at Mark 2:23 / Matt 12:1 / Luke 6:1.
